{{Quote|I am, by right of birth and choice, your true Emperor! Not this Sith usurper, Krayt! It is to me that you all owe your allegiance.|Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Empire-in-exile''',<ref name="Legacy 0.5" /> also known as the '''"true" Empire''',<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> the '''Imperial Remnant''',<ref name="SWL-W½">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> the '''Fel Imperium''',<ref name="SWL-W½" /> or the '''Bastion resistance''' by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Legacy 2006 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref> was a resistance movement founded in [[130 ABY]]. that remained loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] following the [[One Sith]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup]].<ref name="Legacy 0.5" />

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the Empire-in-exile claimed to be the continuation of the [[Fel Empire]] and regain formal power from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]], eventually allying with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[New Jedi Order]]. With the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|downfall]] of the One [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Empire and its allies formed the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].

==History==
As the [[Sith–Imperial War]] came to an end, Roan Fel was poised to establish his government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After a few days, the leader of the [[One Sith]], [[Darth Krayt]], arrived with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Darth Nihl|Nihl]], [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Wyyrlok]] and [[Darth Maladi|Maladi]] and revealed their deception to Emperor Fel, killing his [[Roan Fel's double|double]], and seizing the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|throne]] for himself.<ref name="SWL:B">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Broken]]''</ref>

The real Emperor Fel escaped the assassination attempt, and after seven years as a fugitive, [[Fall of Bastion|landed]] on the planet [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and restored the Fel Empire.<ref name="SWL:B" /> Over the next several months of [[Second Imperial Civil War|resistance]], more and more Imperial military units defected to his territory, subsequently acquiring more, previously stripped, territories. His administration even attempted to form an alliance with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], though the meeting was [[Skirmish on The Wheel|sabotaged]] by [[Jor Torlin]] and [[Morrigan Corde]], agents of the Empire. As a result, [[Gar Stazi|Stazi]] remained distrustful of Fel's Imperials, while the latter were banned from entering [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]].<ref name="SWL:TI">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Trust Issues]]''</ref>

[[File:NewEmpire.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile versus Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]
The first collaboration between the new allies took place during the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]], where the alliance nearly met its end when a Fel loyalist, Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]], threatened with fire on defenseless lifepods in order to force the Sith-loyal [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] into surrender. Admiral Stazi did everything within its power to prevent the Fel loyalists to resort to the tactics of the enemy, coming close to open fire on them, also making it clear to Emperor Fel that the Galactic Alliance fleet were allies of the Empire-in-exile and not vassals.<ref name="Legacy 2006 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>

A short time afterward, the [[New Jedi Order]] agreed to collaborate with Admiral Stazi, even preventing an assassination attempt on his person.<ref name="Legacy 2006 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref> Emperor Fel also arranged to secretly meet with representatives of the Jedi on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref>

At the end of the war, the Fel Empire was merged with Darth Krayt's Empire. The Fel Empire became a part of the new government, the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], which consisted of [[K'Kruhk]], [[Marasiah Fel]] and [[Gar Stazi]].<ref name="PotFW1" />

==Military==
[[File:Bastion_Second_Fleet.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Bastion Second Fleet remained loyal to the Fel instead of Krayt.]]
Following the Sith coup, the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] split among those loyal to Krayt and those loyal to Fel. By [[130 ABY]], the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] was merged with the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], during the time of the Fel Empire. Elements of the Army and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] served Fel, however, the Imperial Military were considerably smaller and were not capable of an offensive for most of the Empire-in-exile's existence, until the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle for Coruscant]]. The Navy used a variety of vessels, including [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigates]], and [[Predator-class fighter]]s. The Imperial Military also  accepted non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] into their ranks. Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]] and General [[Oron Jaeger]] were some commanders serving the Empire-in-exile, and many Sith loyalists ended up defecting to them.
